# TooltipManager

**Class:** `UltraCanvasTooltipManager` · **Group:** [Application, windows and dialogs](../Groups/Application-Windows-And-Dialogs.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTooltipManager.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasTooltipManager.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasTooltipManager.h"`

## What it is for

The application-wide tooltip: shows and hides an element's tooltip text, with a style of its own.
